fact: The Nouakchott Data Centre (Centre de Donnees de Nouakchott), a state facility of 1,372 sq m and 100 racks, was inaugurated by the President on 2025-05-08, marking the start of operation, offering in-country cloud hosting, backup and disaster recovery to public administrations, financial institutions, startups and service providers (AMI).

AMI states the Nouakchott Data Centre, in service from its 2025-05-08 inauguration, holds a Level 3 (Tier III) certification (attributed to an 'AppTime Global Institute', apparently the Uptime Institute) with availability above 99.982 percent.
The US Country Commercial Guide says the government inaugurated a national data centre in Nouakchott in May 2025, EIB-backed; the document does not say it rents to outside customers.
The US Country Commercial Guide states the Nouakchott national data centre inaugurated in May 2025 is Tier III (stated by the guide, no certifier named).

DCD reports Mauritania's first national data centre, the Nouakchott Data Hub, launched in May 2025 and is managed by International Mauritania Telecom (government via Mauripost plus the three telecom operators); the document does not say it rents to outside customers.
DCD reports an EUR 15 million EIB loan backed a Tier III-certified Nouakchott Data Hub, managed by International Mauritania Telecom; certifier not named.

Mauritania's President inaugurated the Nouakchott Data Center, which offers cloud hosting, backup and disaster recovery to public administrations, financial institutions, startups and service providers.
The Nouakchott Data Center holds a level 3 certification (the article names the issuer 'AppTime Global Institute') with over 99.982% availability.
